data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'myllen' meaning 'miller'. The name Millie is a diminutive of the name Amelia or Mildred, which means 'gentle strength' or 'mild power'. The name Millie carries the meaning “Miller's daughter” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. This name has also been popularized in music, particularly in the pop music genre.
data.spiritual_significance: Millie, derived from the names Amelia or Mildred, signifies gentle strength and mild power. This name embodies the qualities of a strong and gentle spirit. Millie can serve as a reminder of the importance of inner strength, humility, and a gentle disposition in our spiritual lives. Additionally, the name Millie can also be seen as a reminder of the importance of milling or grinding down our flaws, just as a miller grinds down grains to make flour – in essence, being willing to undergo spiritual growth and transformation.
